title: Hold or Fold? Texas Real Estate Portfolio Decisions Explained (2026)
description:
We break down what buyers need to know before purchasing a home and why preparation matters more than trying to time the market.

From financing concerns to mindset mistakes, we share honest insights to help buyers feel confident, informed, and ready to take the next step toward homeownership in Texas.

Whether you’re a first-time homebuyer or just starting to look, this conversation will help you understand what really matters when buying a home and how the right real estate strategy can save you time, stress, and money.

👇 In this episode, we discuss:
• Common homebuyer questions we hear every day
• Why preparation beats perfect timing
• What buyers should know before talking to a lender
• How the right real estate team makes a difference
